PHOTO CLEANER: FACT SHEET AND GUIDE SUMMARIES
Source: https://atabany.github.io/photo-cleaner-app/
Last updated: 2026-10-03

=== FACT SHEET ===

Photo Cleaner is an iPhone and iPad app by Mohamed Elatabany for cleaning up your photo library: swipe left to delete and right to keep. It finds duplicates and similar shots, blurry photos, screenshots and large videos, and sends everything you delete to a Trash Bin you review first. It needs iOS 17 or later, is free to download (50 free deletions every week) with an optional Photo Cleaner Pro subscription, and processes everything on-device: no account, no photo uploads, no data collection.

Name: Photo Cleaner (App Store name: "Photo Cleaner: Swipe Cleanup"; subtitle "Delete Duplicates, Free Space")
Developer: Mohamed Elatabany
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6746700862 (App Store ID 6746700862)
Category: Utilities
Devices: iPhone and iPad
Requires: iOS 17 or later
Languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified), Spanish
Rating: 4.6 out of 5 from 35 ratings, US App Store, October 2026
Price: Free to download. The free tier includes up to 50 deletions every week. Photo Cleaner Pro is an optional subscription (yearly with a 3-day free trial, monthly or weekly); a one-time lifetime option is also offered. Prices are shown in the app and on the App Store.

Features:
- Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep.
- Safe Trash Bin: swiped photos are not deleted until you review and empty the Trash Bin. Deletion then goes through iOS's own confirmation, and items move to the Photos app's Recently Deleted album (kept by iOS for 30 days).
- Similars / Duplicates finder: groups exact copies and near-identical shots and marks the best one; you can keep the best only.
- Blur Detection: on-device analysis flags likely out-of-focus shots.
- Largest Files: sorts photos and videos by size, with big 4K videos first.
- Categories: Screenshots, Videos, Live Photos, Bursts, WhatsApp/Messenger photos.
- Memory Lane (photos grouped by month) and Today's Throwback.
- Session recap showing photos cleaned and storage freed; stats and streaks.

Privacy: 100% on-device processing. No account. No photo uploads. No personal data collected. No ads, no tracking. Works offline. Purchases use Apple StoreKit; RevenueCat is used to check subscription status.
Support: email the developer via the App Support link on the App Store page.

=== GUIDE: How to delete duplicate photos on iPhone ===
https://atabany.github.io/photo-cleaner-app/guides/delete-duplicate-photos-iphone.html
1. Built in (iOS 16+): Photos > Albums > Utilities > Duplicates (iOS 17); scroll down to Utilities > Duplicates (iOS 18); Collections > Utilities > Duplicates (iOS 26). Tap Merge on a set, or Select > Select All > Merge. Merge keeps the highest-quality version, combines metadata, and moves the others to Recently Deleted (30 days).
2. The album appears only when duplicates are found; scanning runs in the background.
3. Limits: only identical copies (including different resolution or metadata); similar shots are not grouped; no blur check.
4. Photo Cleaner's Similars / Duplicates finder groups near-identical shots, marks the best, and sends the rest to the Trash Bin for review.

=== GUIDE: How to free up iPhone storage from Photos ===
https://atabany.github.io/photo-cleaner-app/guides/free-up-iphone-storage-photos.html
Check Settings > General > iPhone Storage first. Then, roughly in order of space saved: (1) videos: Media Types > Videos, swipe up on a video to see its size; Settings > Camera > Record Video shows size per minute; (2) Live Photos: Media Types > Live Photos; Settings > Camera > Preserve Settings > Live Photo; (3) screenshots: Media Types > Screenshots, Select and drag; (4) bursts: open a burst > Select > choose frames > Done > Keep Only Favorites; (5) duplicates: Utilities > Duplicates > Merge; (6) blurry photos: no built-in filter. Finally empty Utilities > Recently Deleted (Select > Delete All), because deleted items keep using space for 30 days.

=== GUIDE: How to clean up your camera roll fast ===
https://atabany.github.io/photo-cleaner-app/guides/clean-up-camera-roll-fast.html
Use the swipe method: one photo at a time, left to delete, right to keep. Ten minutes a day on one month or one category (screenshots first, then similar shots, large videos, then month by month). Review the Trash Bin before emptying it. Keep anything you hesitate on. In the Photos app, swiping only navigates; deleting needs the trash icon or grid selection.

=== GUIDE: How to find and delete blurry photos on iPhone ===
https://atabany.github.io/photo-cleaner-app/guides/delete-blurry-photos-iphone.html
Photos has no blur filter. Manually: enlarge thumbnails, check low-light and moving shots, zoom to confirm, Select and delete; trim Bursts to the sharpest frame. Photo Cleaner's Blur Detection flags likely out-of-focus shots on-device for review. Keep intentional blur and one-of-a-kind moments. Prevent blur: clean the lens, tap to focus, hold still in Night mode.

=== GUIDE: How to delete all screenshots on iPhone ===
https://atabany.github.io/photo-cleaner-app/guides/delete-screenshots-iphone.html
Photos > Media Types > Screenshots > Select, then tap the first screenshot and drag across rows to select many; tap the trash icon and confirm. Screen recordings are in Media Types > Screen Recordings. Check for tickets, receipts and codes first. After taking a screenshot, tap the preview and choose Done > Delete Screenshot (or Copy and Delete) to avoid saving it.

=== GUIDE: How to find large videos on iPhone ===
https://atabany.github.io/photo-cleaner-app/guides/find-large-videos-iphone.html
Photos cannot sort by size. Browse Media Types > Videos (durations on thumbnails) and swipe up on a video to see file size; check Settings > General > iPhone Storage for a recommendation to review videos. Photo Cleaner's Largest Files lists the biggest photos and videos first. Save space without deleting: trim (Edit > Save Video as New Clip), move to a computer or drive, or use iCloud Photos with Optimize iPhone Storage. Record smaller: lower resolution/frame rate in Settings > Camera > Record Video; Formats > High Efficiency.

=== GUIDE: iPhone storage full with iCloud Photos ===
https://atabany.github.io/photo-cleaner-app/guides/iphone-storage-full-icloud-photos.html
iPhone storage (Settings > General > iPhone Storage) and iCloud storage (Settings > [your name] > iCloud) are separate. With iCloud Photos on, Settings > [your name] > iCloud > Photos > Optimize iPhone Storage keeps originals in iCloud and smaller versions on the device; Download and Keep Originals keeps everything locally. iCloud Photos is sync, not backup: deleting a photo on any device deletes it everywhere, whichever app you use. Deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days (recoverable, locked with Face ID on iOS 17+), and still use device space until removed.

=== COMPARISON (checked October 2026; made by the Photo Cleaner developer) ===
https://atabany.github.io/photo-cleaner-app/compare/best-photo-cleaner-apps-iphone.html
Apple Photos (built in): free; Duplicates album merges identical copies; no swipe review, no similar-shot grouping, no blur detection, no sort by size.
Photo Cleaner: swipe review, duplicates and similar shots with best-shot marking, blur detection, Largest Files, on-device, free tier with up to 50 deletions every week.
Swipewipe and Slidebox: swipe-based review; Slidebox also sorts photos into albums while reviewing.
Cleanup and CleanMy(R)Phone: group duplicate and similar photos; CleanMy(R)Phone also flags blurry photos.
Features not confirmed from public documentation are not claimed.
